items.fixture_label: SEVENEDGE playbook review: five synthetic clauses, C3 is the sole blocker

contract.parties: Fixture Customer Ltd | Fixture Supplier Ltd

clauses.heading: Supplier liability
clauses.summary: Supplier liability is capped at 12 months of fees.
clauses.verbatim_key_sentence: The supplier liability cap is twelve months of fees.

clauses.heading: Customer termination
clauses.summary: Customer may terminate for convenience on 30 days notice.
clauses.verbatim_key_sentence: The customer may terminate for convenience on thirty days notice.

clauses.heading: Supplier ownership
clauses.summary: Supplier owns customer data and all work built specifically for the customer.
clauses.verbatim_key_sentence: The supplier owns all customer data and all work built specifically for the customer.

clauses.heading: Payment
clauses.summary: Correct invoices are payable net 30, with annual increases capped at 5%.
clauses.verbatim_key_sentence: Correct invoices are payable net thirty days and annual price increases are capped at five percent.

clauses.heading: Confidentiality
clauses.summary: Confidentiality is mutual and survives for 3 years.
clauses.verbatim_key_sentence: Mutual confidentiality obligations survive termination for three years.

C1.explanation: The synthetic clause matches the corresponding playbook position.

C3.which_hard_limit: Supplier claims ownership of our data or of work built specifically for us.
C3.explanation: Supplier claims ownership of customer data and customer-specific work.
C3.business_impact: Customer loses ownership of its data and bespoke deliverables.
C3.suggested_redline: The customer owns its data and all work built specifically for the customer.
C3.question_for_counsel: Confirm customer ownership of data and bespoke deliverables.
